    Description
    CodeSystemIndexes
    The runtime indexes for one code system version, loaded lazily per executor JVM from the store.
    ConceptDictionary
    The concept dictionary for one code system version: the mapping between concept codes and the dense integer identifiers that address the runtime bitmaps, plus each concept's status, display, and defining metadata.
    ConceptMapIndex
    The concept map index: the mappings of every imported FHIR ConceptMap, keyed by canonical URL and addressable in both directions.
    Description
    One description of a concept: a SNOMED description or a FHIR designation.
    DescriptionIndex
    The description index for one code system version: the terms of each concept with their language, type, and (for SNOMED) language-reference-set acceptability.
    DescriptionOrder
    The order in which a concept's descriptions are held, fixed by their content so that no result derived from them depends on the order the store's rows were read.
    HierarchyIndex
    The hierarchy index for one code system version, built from the precomputed transitive closure.
    PropertyIndex
    The scalar property index for one code system version: the declared FHIR CodeSystem properties of each concept (integer, boolean, code, string, decimal, and dateTime values).
    PropertyValue
    A single scalar property value of a concept: the property code, the declared FHIR value type (integer, boolean, code, string, decimal, or dateTime), and the value encoded as a string.
    RefsetIndex
    The reference set membership index for one code system version: which concepts belong to each reference set, and the association targets that drive SNOMED implicit concept maps.
    RelationshipIndex
    The attribute relationship index for one code system version.
